articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch midweek Starlink mission on Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral
articles.summary: The Starlink 6-98 mission will add 29 Starlink V2 Mini Optimized satellites to the low Earth orbit constellation. Liftoff from pad 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is scheduled for 1:08 p.m. EST (1808 UTC).
